messages:
Devin (Sales): starting handoff for Citrine Health -> CS. quick context below, tagging ops and eng for tech items.

Devin (Sales): Account: Citrine Health (Enterprise). ARR $250k/yr. Signed 2026-02-10. Pilot target: 6 weeks starting ~2026-03-15. Data residency: EU. DPA signed. Model pin requested.

Devin (Sales): Customer asks: private deployment (VPC peering), AWS KMS, static egress IPs, and ability to block external egress during pilot. They also want SSO (Okta) test user.

Olivia (CSM): I'll own CS kickoff and weekly success plan. Requested primary contacts & top success metrics. Proposed kickoff Thurs 2026-03-11 10:00 PT.

Devin (Sales): Primary contact: Maya Li (IT Dir) maya@citrinehealth.com. Secondary: Andre Gomez (ML Eng). Top metrics they care about: 1) p95 latency <300ms for conv flows, 2) cost per 1k requests target (give estimate), 3) integration with EHR for de-identified summaries.

Anya (Solutions Eng): noted. infra items: VPC peering, route tables, static egress IPs for allowlisting, AWS KMS (HSM optional). Model pinning to redwood/llama2-70b v1.2 requires enterprise license signoff (est 7-10d). fallback: llama2-13b if license blocks.

Anya (Solutions Eng): dropping initial infra snippet here for visibility:
```
model: redwood/llama2-70b
pin_version: "v1.2.0"
quantization: int8
network: vpc-peering
kms: aws-kms
static_egress: [52.12.34.56]
```

Anya (Solutions Eng): I'll produce a full runbook (network checklist, required IAM roles, sample terraform snippets) by EOD Mon.

Raj (Support): I'll create the onboarding ticket and own entitlement & tenant setup. Need Okta admin or a test user with SSO metadata. Creating ticket now.

oncall-bot: Ticket created: INC-8342 — "Citrine Health private deploy / onboarding" assigned Raj (Support) priority P2 ETA: initial contact 48h.

Olivia (CSM): action items I captured:
- Olivia: run kickoff, own success plan & weekly check-ins
- Anya: infra runbook + fallback config + rollout policy
- Raj: open ticket, entitlement, tenant setup, health checks
- Devin: deliver Okta test user, network diagram, legal contacts

Olivia (CSM): account health: flagged as "At-Risk (medium)" due to custom infra + licensing dependency. will reassess post-kickoff. tagging @Anya @Raj for blockers.

Devin (Sales): uploaded contract, DPA, and their network diagram to drive: https://redwood.app/drive/citrine/contract and firewall spreadsheet. Okta test account sent in calendar invite.

Anya (Solutions Eng): one more risk: customer requires egress block during pilot. we need to validate VPC peering + NAT config. if pinning delays, start pilot on llama2-13b quantized; performance targets should still be achievable. I'll attach perf sims to runbook.

Raj (Support): adding onboarding checklist to INC-8342. will request Okta metadata and set tenant provisioning tasks. ping me for escalations.

Olivia (CSM): good — after kickoff I'll publish success plan + next steps in Gainsight and link to INC-8342. please DM if anything urgent before the call. :thumbsup:
